name: Peak-End Rule
axiom: An experience is remembered by its peak and its ending, not its average.
trigger: A smooth session is rated harshly because its last screen failed.
checklist: End every flow on a clear confirmation that names what happens next.
Soften the most intense step: the peak sets the rating more than the middle.
Do not spend effort smoothing a middle the ending will overwrite.

antiPattern.violation: A fast checkout ends on a paywall error, so the whole flow is remembered as bad.
antiPattern.remediation: The last screen thanks the person and confirms the order.

parametricParams.caption: MEMORY FOLLOWS THE PEAK AND THE END

academicOrigin.title: When More Pain Is Preferred to Less: Adding a Better End
